response.description:
Global Provisioned Throughput (PTU) reservations are now region-agnostic, enabling a single reservation to cover Global PTU deployments across multiple regions. Why it matters:Optimize savings: One reservation can apply across regions, improving utilization and reducing stranded capacity. Increase flexibility: Deploy workloads where capacity is available without needing region-specific reservations.Simplify cost management: Consolidate reservations instead of managing multiple regional commitments.This builds on the benefits of provisioned throughput—predictable performance, allocated capacity, and cost savings for high-throughput workloads.Learn
